comment: The img src is URL.createObjectURL(file) for a picked PNG/JPEG/WebP: always a blob: URL, set as an attribute by React, never parsed as HTML. A blob: URL in cannot run script. See docs/security/codeql-triage.md.
Intended: the setup CLI prints the admin password it just generated, once, to the operator's own terminal (it is also in the 0600 .env). Not a server log. See docs/security/codeql-triage.md.

Intended: the local demo seeder prints the demo account's password (generated, or the operator's own DEMO_PASSWORD) once to the terminal that ran it. Not a server log. See docs/security/codeql-triage.md.
Intended: prompt templates shipped in the repo (industry/prompts/*.md) are the body of the model request. No user file or secret is read on this path. See docs/security/codeql-triage.md.
